en_title: Samuel L. Jackson Confirms Nick Fury Will Return in Avengers: Secret Wars
cn_title: 塞缪尔·杰克逊确认尼克·弗瑞将在《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》回归
subtitle: 这部没有，下一部有
opus_summary: 塞缪尔·杰克逊确认，尼克·弗瑞不会出现在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中，但将在《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》回归。漫威只告知他会参演下一部电影，尚未透露角色戏份。

paragraphs.en: Samuel L. Jackson has confirmed that we won’t be seeing Nick Fury in Avengers: Doomsday, but said that his character is set to return in Avengers: Secret Wars.
paragraphs.cn: 塞缪尔·杰克逊确认，尼克·弗瑞不会出现在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》中，但会在《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》回归。

paragraphs.en: Jackson revealed this information in a red carpet interview with The Direct ahead of the premier for The Beast, his newest film. After The Direct’s interviewer noted that Nick Fury hasn’t been spotted in a Marvel movie for some time, Jackson said that he will be in the next film after Doomsday — which, according to the current slate laid out by Marvel Studios, is Avengers: Secret Wars.
paragraphs.cn: 杰克逊是在新片《The Beast》首映前接受The Direct红毯采访时透露这一消息的。采访者提到，尼克·弗瑞已经有一段时间没在漫威电影中露面；杰克逊随后表示，弗瑞会出现在《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》之后的下一部电影中。按照漫威影业目前公布的片单，那部电影就是《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》。

paragraphs.en: He didn’t elaborate on what we can expect from Fury’s appearance in this movie, saying that Marvel only told him that he’d be in it and nothing more.
paragraphs.cn: 杰克逊没有透露弗瑞在片中会有怎样的戏份。他说，漫威只告诉他会参演，除此之外什么也没说。

paragraphs.en: "Next movie... [The] movie after this one,” he told the outlet. “I have no idea. [Marvel] hasn't told me anything, other than, 'You're not gonna be in this movie. You'll be in the next.'"
paragraphs.cn: 他告诉The Direct：「下一部电影……这部之后的那部。我什么都不知道。漫威除了告诉我‘你不会出演这部，你会出演下一部’，其他什么也没说。」

paragraphs.en: Thus far, Marvel has been keeping the cast of Secret Wars close to its chest; in September, Noah Jupe was added to the roster of actors set to star in the film in an as-yet unrevealed role. Anthony Mackie has also been confirmed for the movie, but says he won’t be able start filming until his run in a broadway showing of Macbeth ends in July 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 到目前为止，漫威仍对《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》的演员阵容守口如瓶。今年9月，Noah Jupe加入了该片演员阵容，但角色尚未公布。Anthony Mackie也已确认参演，不过他说，自己要等到2027年7月百老汇版《麦克白》的演出结束后，才能开始拍摄。

paragraphs.en: Secret Wars recently ran into some significant roadblocks, with multiple insiders claiming that filming for the project has been delayed until early 2027 , most likely in January. Thus far, no reason for this delay has been revealed, but it’s enough to spark anxiety among fans — many of whom feel that Doomsday needs to be a home run of a movie to keep interest in the current MCU saga.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》近期似乎遇到了重大阻碍：多名知情人士称，影片拍摄已推迟至2027年初，最有可能在1月开拍。目前尚不清楚延期原因，但消息已足以让粉丝感到不安。许多人认为，《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》必须足够出色，才能让观众继续关注当前的漫威电影宇宙篇章。

paragraphs.en: Secret Wars is set to cap off the Russo brothers’ involvement with the MCU, with the two saying in June 2026 that they won’t be directing a third film to create a new Avengers trilogy. The movie marks the sixth major cross-over event in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, and will serve as the final chapter in the Multiverse saga, putting an end to the innumerable variations of characters that have been popping up in Marvel’s TV series and films over the MCU’s last three phases.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟6：秘密战争》将为罗素兄弟参与漫威电影宇宙的历程画上句号。两人在2026年6月表示，不会再执导第三部电影，将这几部作品组成新的《复仇者联盟》三部曲。这部电影是漫威电影宇宙的第六部大型联动作品，也将为「多元宇宙传奇」收尾，结束过去三个阶段里不断出现在漫威剧集和电影中的无数角色变体的故事。

paragraphs.en: Recent reporting indicates that the Battleworld will be involved somehow, given that it serves as the setting for the Secret Wars comic storyline, though this hasn’t been confirmed. It would be a fitting way for the Multiverse Saga to end, though, as Battleworld is a patchwork planet made up of several different versions of Earth combined by none other than Dr Doom.
paragraphs.cn: 近期报道指出，「战斗世界」可能会以某种形式出现在电影中，因为它是《秘密战争》漫画故事的舞台，不过这一消息尚未得到证实。用它来结束「多元宇宙传奇」倒也合适：战斗世界是一颗拼接而成的星球，由毁灭博士将多个不同版本的地球合并而成。

paragraphs.en: For now, we’ll just have to wait and see what’s in store, and if Avengers: Doomsday lives up to the hype. The movie releases in theaters on December 18, 2026.
paragraphs.cn: 眼下，我们只能等待后续消息，看看《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》能否不负期待。该片将于2026年12月18日在影院上映。
